def verify_row(row):

def arrays(path):

def finite(a,shape,dtype,name):
    require(a.shape==shape and a.dtype==np.dtype(dtype) and np.isfinite(a).all(),'Saved array contract '+name)
def close(a,b,name,tol=64*np.finfo(float).eps):
    require(np.all(np.isfinite(a)) and np.all(np.isfinite(b)) and np.all(np.abs(np.asarray(a)-b)<=tol*np.maximum(1.,np.abs(b))),'Saved arithmetic '+name)
def unit(q):
    require(np.isfinite(q).all() and np.max(np.abs(np.sum(q*q,axis=-1)-1))<=1e-12,'Unit quaternion input')
    return q
def multiply(a,b):
    # Scalar Hamilton products; independent from the producer's vector formula.
    a=np.asarray(a);b=np.asarray(b);out=np.empty(np.broadcast_shapes(a.shape,b.shape))
    aa=np.broadcast_to(a,out.shape).reshape(-1,4);bb=np.broadcast_to(b,out.shape).reshape(-1,4)
    for i,(x,y) in enumerate(zip(aa,bb)):
        w,p,q,r=map(float,x);v,s,t,u=map(float,y)
        out.reshape(-1,4)[i]=[w*v-p*s-q*t-r*u,w*s+p*v+q*u-r*t,w*t-p*u+q*v+r*s,w*u+p*t-q*s+r*v]
    return out
def conjugate(q):
    a=np.array(q,copy=True);a[...,1:]*=-1;return a
def exp(aa):
    a=np.asarray(aa,dtype=np.float64).reshape(-1,3);out=[]
    for v in a:
        theta=math.sqrt(math.fsum(float(x)*float(x) for x in v))
        scale=math.sin(theta/2)/theta if theta else .5
        out.append([math.cos(theta/2),*(v*scale)])
    return np.array(out).reshape(np.shape(aa)[:-1]+(4,))
def matrix(q):
    q=unit(np.asarray(q));out=[]
    for w,x,y,z in q.reshape(-1,4):
        n=w*w+x*x+y*y+z*z;s=2/n
        out.append([[1-s*(y*y+z*z),s*(x*y-w*z),s*(x*z+w*y)],
                    [s*(x*y+w*z),1-s*(x*x+z*z),s*(y*z-w*x)],
                    [s*(x*z-w*y),s*(y*z+w*x),1-s*(x*x+y*y)]])
    return np.asarray(out).reshape(q.shape[:-1]+(3,3))
def nearest(q,reference):
    # Same mathematical covering-space definition, independent scalar arithmetic.
    q=np.array(unit(q),copy=True)
    nonzero=np.flatnonzero(q)
    if q[0]<0 or (q[0]==0 and q[nonzero[0]]<0):q=-q
    length=math.sqrt(math.fsum(float(x)*float(x) for x in q[1:]))
    theta=2*math.atan2(length,float(q[0]))
    rn=math.sqrt(math.fsum(float(x)*float(x) for x in reference))
    axis=q[1:]/length if length else (reference/rn if rn else np.array([1.,0.,0.]))
    candidates=[axis*(theta+2*math.pi*k) for k in (-1,0,1)]
    distances=[math.fsum(float(x)*float(x) for x in c-reference) for c in candidates]
    j=int(np.argmin(distances));return candidates[j],(-1,0,1)[j]
def normals(vertices,faces):
    tri=vertices[...,faces,:];cross=np.cross(tri[...,1,:]-tri[...,0,:],tri[...,2,:]-tri[...,0,:])
    length=np.sqrt(np.sum(cross*cross,axis=-1));require(np.isfinite(length).all() and np.all(length>1e-15),'No saved degenerate face')
    return cross/length[...,None]

    require(aa.tobytes()==d['original_axisangles_float32'].tobytes()==d['recovered_axisangles_float32'][0].tobytes()==a['actual_recovered_axisangles_float32'][0].tobytes(),'OriginalAA q0 byte identity')

    return check_complete(i,r,p['cases'][str(i)],p,raw)

def main():
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser();parser.add_argument('freeze');parser.add_argument('protocol_sha256');args=parser.parse_args()
